description: Registration data for a domain from the registry's RDAP server (IANA bootstrap): registrar, created/updated/expiry dates, days until expiry with ok/expiring_soon/expired status, EPP status codes, nameservers and DNSSEC. Works for gTLDs and ccTLDs that publish RDAP. Deterministic, no AI. Price: $0.002 USDC per call via x402 (Base); the first 5 calls per day per client are free.
name: domain_expiry
title: Domain registration and expiry date via RDAP
